[[File:SpeedIcon.png|20px|Speed]]Fast (Without Bees) |hidden = No |immunity = None }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Beehive''' was an enemy that only appeared in [[Eggy Island]] hard mode as part of the [[Spring 2020 Event]]. This did not appear in easy mode. This enemy moved incredibly quickly with bees. At half health (175), the '''Beehive''' would lose its bees and its speed would be reduced. ==Appearance== The '''Beehive''' had a yellow torso and legs, and cyan blue skin. It also had a sad face. It wore a yellow neckguard. When the '''Beehive''' was covered in bees, it had a beehive on its head. When it was not covered with bees it had a basic smile and the beehive was removed. ==Strategy== *Try to immediately remove the bees from the '''Beehive'''. *As the '''Beehive''' appear in large numbers, it is recommended to use the [[Mortar]] or [[Rocketeer]] to defeat these. **If these are not at hand, the [[Minigunner]] can be sufficient. *You can use the [[Pyromancer]], [[Freezer]], [[Frost Blaster]] and [[Electroshocker]] to slow the '''Beehive''' down so that it is easier to attack. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} BeehiveFace.png|'''Beehive's''' face, with bees variant NoobFace.png|'''Beehive's''' face, without bees variant }} ==Trivia== *This was the first enemy to have a negative downgrade when it lost health. *The '''Beehive''' looked similar to the [[Sugrawr]] without the bees. ==Update History== *'''6 April 2020''' - [[Release v1.9|Release v1.9.0]] **'''Beehive''' added. *'''26 May 2020''' - [[Release v1.11|Release v1.11.0]] **'''Beehive''' removed. {{EggyIsland|[[Sir Hopsalot]]
